bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated through three distinct methods: generative coreference resolution accuracy on the Winogender benchmark (comparing stereotypical vs. non-stereotypical associations), automated scoring of English translations from 26 source languages to detect translation misgendering harms, and measuring the toxicity probability of generated continuations when prompted with gender identity terms.
Prompting the model with templates containing ethnic identity terms and evaluating the toxicity probability of the generated continuations using the Perspective API.
Prompting the model with templates containing religious identity terms and evaluating the toxicity probability of the generated continuations using the Perspective API.
Prompting the model with templates containing country identity terms and evaluating the toxicity probability of the generated continuations using the Perspective API.
Prompting the model with templates containing occupation identity terms and evaluating the toxicity probability of the generated continuations using the Perspective API.
